title: báty / öcs, nővér / húg — Older and Younger

sections.content: English 'brother' and 'sister' don't say who's older. Hungarian always does: báty (older brother) vs öcs (younger brother), nővér (older sister) vs húg (younger sister). Add the possessive suffix to talk about your own: bátyám, öcsém, nővérem, húgom.
sections.title: Age-marked siblings

sections.content: báty/öcs and nővér/húg are pairs split by age, not just gender — mixing up báty and öcs is like saying 'older' when you mean 'younger.'
